description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Grim Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Grim Monolith token.
Activate the Grim Monolith token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 using the other Grim Monolith token.
Repeat from step 2.
